correctness.rationale: The graph, all 742 nonempty independent faces, all 367 matched face pairs, all 2816 oriented Hasse incidences and a complete 742-vertex acyclicity topological ordering are independently regenerated. One critical 0-cell and seven critical 3-cells imply precisely seven integral 3-spheres via discrete Morse theory. Direct signed fixed-face traces and orbit-conflict independence polynomial traces agree for each of 384 automorphisms. Exact Fourier projections give multiplicity 3 at trivial translation and 1 at each weight-three character, the expected S4 character and S3 stabilizer signs. The standalone actual packaged verifier succeeded. The theorem is limited to Q4 and rational G-homology.

value.rationale: Q4 is a canonical small hypercube whose independence complex has a seven-dimensional homology group and a large natural 384-element group. Its decomposition into two distinct absolutely irreducible rational symmetry types (a three-dimensional translation-fixed sign-standard component and a four-dimensional monomial weight-three component) is a complete natural equivariant classification, not a renaming of the Betti number. It distinguishes three T-invariant classes from zero full-G invariants and identifies which translation Fourier modes actually support homology. This structural information is neither forced by the known seven-sphere homotopy type nor merely a cheap numerical normalization check. No family theorem or integral lattice result is needed or claimed.
